pack-land: A sealed foil trading card booster pack landing on a wooden table: one soft padded thump and a short crinkle of foil settling. Close-up, dry, no reverb, no music, no voices.
pack-hover: A quick light crinkle of a foil wrapper being gently squeezed in a hand, crisp and small. Close-up, dry, no reverb, no music, no voices.
tear-scrub: Continuous steady ripping of a metallic foil wrapper, crisp crackling plastic tear, even and loopable. Close-up, dry, no reverb, no music, no voices.
tear: One fast satisfying rip of a foil trading card booster pack being torn open across the top, sharp crackling tear that ends with a little pop. Close-up, dry, no reverb, no music, no voices.
pack-burst: A burst of magical light as a pack opens: airy whoosh swelling up with glittering sparkles and a soft glassy shimmer, fantasy card game reward.
cards-slide: A fresh stack of trading cards sliding out of a foil pack, smooth paper swish with a tiny flutter. Close-up, dry, no reverb, no music, no voices.
deal: A single trading card flicked across a table, very short paper swish. Close-up, dry, no reverb, no music, no voices.
flip: A single trading card being flipped face up onto a table, crisp short card-stock snap with a light tap. Close-up, dry, no reverb, no music, no voices.
uncommon: A single short soft glassy chime with a tiny sparkle tail, subtle reward sound for a card game.
rare: A bright magical shimmer sting with a glassy bell chime and rising sparkle, short triumphant rare card reveal in a fantasy card game.
mythic: Epic cinematic reveal sting: a deep sub boom, then a swelling shimmering pad with a rising harp glissando and a burst of sparkles, legendary mythic rare pull in a fantasy card game.
select: A soft subtle interface click with a tiny bright tick, gentle tactile select sound for a card game. Very short.
deselect: A soft low interface click, gentle un-select tick, very short, slightly duller than a select sound.
pick: A card whooshing into a deck with a soft wooden thump and a small bright sparkle, satisfying confirm sound for a card game.
burn: A trading card igniting and burning up: quick fire whoosh, crackle and a flutter of embers, short.
pack-arrive: A stack of cards sliding fast across a table and landing with a soft slap, passed from another player. Close-up, dry, no reverb, no music, no voices.
pack-pass: A stack of cards swept quickly off a table, short swish going away. Close-up, dry, no reverb, no music, no voices.
tick: A single loud sharp woodblock knock, like a wooden clock tick: bright, clear and hollow with a short ringing decay. Close-up, dry, no music.
tap: A trading card being turned sideways on a felt table, soft paper shuffle and tap. Close-up, dry, no reverb, no music, no voices.
zoom-open: A trading card lifting off a table toward the viewer: a soft airy whoosh swelling up with a tiny bright shimmer, short and gentle.
zoom-close: A trading card settling back down onto a table: a soft airy whoosh falling away and a light tap, short and gentle.
row-hover: A very quiet tiny soft tick with a hint of foil shimmer, barely-there interface hover sound, extremely short and subtle.
turn-over: A trading card being turned over in the hand: a quick paper flutter and a soft snap as it lands on its other face. Close-up, dry, no reverb, no music, no voices.
